fusions.name: Loose Strands
fusions.desc: Flicks 4 frayed strands in a spread to 5 tiles; each deals 3 damage.

fusions.name: Braided Snare
fusions.desc: A braided lash at an enemy up to 6 tiles away deals 8 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range, and slows it by 30% for 3 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Woven Guard
fusions.desc: Wraps you in braided strands that absorb the next 18 damage for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrapped in the Ends
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield of 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
